listings.name: Daewoong Foundation Global Scholarship Program (GSP)
listings.summary: International students currently enrolled in universities or graduate schools in Korea. Support: monthly scholarship of KRW 500,000, workplace experience (internship), employment classes, capacity-building education, employment opportunities. Selection period: ongoing.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: GKS Exchange Students Program
listings.summary: Supports the expansion of international student exchange to enhance the international competitiveness of domestic universities, while providing exchange students with opportunities to understand Korean education and culture. Scholarship duration 4 months (1 semester); approximately 500 international students.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) - Graduate Degrees (Master's and Doctoral Degrees)
listings.summary: General Programs covering various fields in humanities, social sciences, natural sciences and arts; Specialized Programs (R&D, Global Network). Benefits: airfare, language training costs, tuition, and study allowances.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) - Undergraduate Degrees (including Associate Degree)
listings.summary: South Korea's representative scholarship program that aims to attract talented students worldwide to support their pursuit of degrees and more. Korean language training + degree programs. Scholarship benefits: airfare, language training costs, tuition, and study allowances.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: Korea Foundation (KF) Fellowship for Korean Studies Graduate Students
listings.summary: Approximately 150 students worldwide per year, 1 year of support. Master's and Doctoral programs in Korean Studies from over 30 countries. Support: tuition fees (amount varies by region, country, and local cost of living).
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: Korea National University of Arts (K-Arts) AMA+ Scholarship Program for Developing Countries' Artistic Talent
listings.summary: Outstanding artistic talent from OECD DAC recipient countries (140 countries). Supported fields: Arts (Music, Dance, Fine Arts, Film, Theater, Korean Traditional Arts). Undergraduate and Graduate. Support: airfare, monthly living allowance, Korean language training, tuition fees, medical insurance.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: Korea-Japan Future Talent Invitational Program
listings.summary: Selection and support for bachelor's and associate degree scholarship students. Up to 20 students annually, all fields. Benefits: tuition fees, language training expenses, academic allowance, round-trip airfare.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: Korea-Japan Joint Higher Education Student Exchange Program - Bachelor's 1-Year Program
listings.summary: Aims to foster talent who will serve as bridges between Korea and Japan. Up to 30 students annually, all fields, 1 year. Benefits: tuition fees, academic allowance, round-trip airfare.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: Korea-Japan Joint Higher Education Student Exchange Program - Bachelor's Short-Term Program
listings.summary: Up to 180 students annually, all fields, 2-5 weeks. Benefits: programme participation expenses. Eligibility: Japanese nationality, ages 18-30, currently enrolled undergraduate at a Japanese university.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: Korea-Japan Joint Higher Education Student Exchange Program - Master's and Doctoral Degree Programs
listings.summary: Up to 20 students annually, all fields; 3 years for master's, 4 years for doctoral (includes 1 year of Korean language training). Benefits: tuition fees, language training expenses, academic allowance, round-trip airfare.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)

listings.name: POSCO TJ Park Foundation Scholarships for Asian Students Studying in Korea
listings.summary: 50 students. Asian nationals planning to enroll in Master's or Doctoral programs in the following academic year. All academic fields (excluding MBA). Support: tuition, living expenses, arrival allowance, language excellence scholarships. Application period: May.
listings.source_name: Study in Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea)
